title: Istio路由超时故障：上游健康但HTTP请求超过代理预算
body:
## 操作任务
实现task.py的repair(config)，仅把精确/slow路由的timeout从0.05秒改为批准的0.5秒，返回深拷贝，保持cluster连接超时、健康路由及其他配置。受控上游/slow直接请求约0.16秒且200，原代理此路由504，健康路由200；修复后慢请求200。

## 产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；真实Envoy、独立上游和健康请求对照。

## 能力边界
仅验证自有network namespace与loopback下的HTTP路由预算，不经过真实Istio控制面，不证明生产延迟、SLO或上游容量；提高超时须先获得业务批准。
answer: 区分已建立连接后的路由响应预算与连接建立预算，核对直接上游和健康路径，再按批准范围调整。
explanation: 上游本身可以成功但响应慢于代理路由预算；连接成功不等于请求会在预算内结束。
rubric: 直接上游和健康路由200、原代理慢路由504，定向调整后200且连接超时不变。
review_note: 原模块故障场景真实缺口，新增题号绑定冻结空名额；不计原214故障和旧题改编。

exercise.environment: 私有WSL普通student；实际Envoy、私有grpcio和自有user/net namespace
exercise.operation: 仅调整批准的HTTP慢路由响应预算，保留连接和健康路由设置。
exercise.validation_scope: 仅验证自有network namespace与loopback下的HTTP路由预算，不经过真实Istio控制面，不证明生产延迟、SLO或上游容量；提高超时须先获得业务批准。

import os,pathlib,subprocess,sys
assert os.getuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
before=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net');p=subprocess.run(['unshare','-Urn','--',sys.executable,'-B','checks/rls_worker.py'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35)
print(p.stdout,flush=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stdout+p.stderr;assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')==before
assert 'NATIVE_ENVOY_HTTP_ROUTE_BUDGET_RECOVERY_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_HEALTH_ROUTE_UNCHANGED' in p.stdout

test_files.checks/rls_worker.py:
import copy,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks')]
import task
from envoy_fixture import Envoy,Upstream,bootstrap,hcm,request
assert os.getuid()==0
subprocess.run(['ip','link','set','lo','up'],check=True,capture_output=True)
def status(method,path,index):
 if path=='/slow':time.sleep(.16)
 return 200
with Upstream(status=status) as upstream:
 assert request('http://127.0.0.1:'+str(upstream.port),'/slow')[0]==200
 config=bootstrap(upstream.port);manager=hcm(config);manager['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes']=[{'match':{'path':'/slow'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'0.05s'}},{'match':{'path':'/health'},'route':{'cluster':'service','timeout':'1s'}}];original=copy.deepcopy(config)
 with Envoy(config) as before:
  assert before.request('/health')[0]==200 and before.request('/slow')[0]==504
 time.sleep(.2)
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_HTTP_ROUTE_504_DIRECT_SLOW_UPSTREAM_AND_HEALTH_200',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:adjust_only_approved_http_route_timeout',flush=True)
 try:fixed=task.repair(config)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('approved route budget repair failed') from error
 expected=copy.deepcopy(original);hcm(expected)['route_config']['virtual_hosts'][0]['routes'][0]['route']['timeout']='0.5s'
 assert config==original and fixed==expected,'only approved route timeout may change'
 with Envoy(fixed) as after:
  started=time.monotonic();assert after.request('/slow')[0]==200 and time.monotonic()-started>=.12;assert after.request('/health')[0]==200
 assert [x['path'] for x in upstream.requests]==['/slow','/health','/slow','/slow','/health']
 print('NATIVE_ENVOY_HTTP_ROUTE_BUDGET_RECOVERY_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_HEALTH_ROUTE_UNCHANGED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
